3.finding: Withdraw the unsupported positive comparison after a genuine catalogue-based reconstruction challenge. Grant child/adolescent clinical assessment and therapy, lifespan/attachment study, actual didactic design with primary pupils, youth-resilience/educator work and language acquisition/dyslexia. These are stronger partial contributions than the earlier cache-only challenge established. Both upbringing/support and education/school-development concepts still lack sustained integrated pedagogical/educational inquiry in a defensible 24-course response. General policy, ethics, history, sociology and rhetoric additions do not supply it. Approve no-defensible-ucr-match; no title, licence or numerical quota rule is imposed.

comparabilityQuestion.strongestPositive: Substantial developmental, social and abnormal psychology, qualitative/statistical research, resilience-to-extremism project in schools and primary-school rhetoric activity genuinely address parts of child development.
comparabilityQuestion.strongestNegative: The 24-course curriculum is heavily psychological/neuroscientific, lacking a continuing academic programme in upbringing and parenting support, pedagogical/education-science theory and design, educational practice and its specific research. Under CP119/CP330, a coherent psychology programme does not by itself respond to pedagogical sciences.
specificCourseFlags: MCCCOMM213 uses primary-school engagement; MCCCOMM311 instead concerns climate messaging, not child pedagogy.
HCBCOGN212, HCBCOGN311, HCBCOGN312 and HCBLIFE212 are neuroscience/life-science perspectives, not educational design.
HCBPSYC312 offers clinical diagnostics/therapy, not necessarily parenting support.
